newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN KB SAYS TALKS WITH RABOBANK EXPLORATORY.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN KB SAYS TALKS WITH RABOBANK EXPLORATORY.

text.p: Belgian Kredietbank (KB) said on Thursday it was holding exploratory talks with Dutch co-operative bank Rabobank as part of expansion plans.
The Belgian Trends weekly magazine earlier reported that Rabobank and KB were holding discreet talks, to be finalised in the summer, on forging a close alliance.

KB spokesman Piet Jaspaert reiterated comments by chief executive officer Marcel Cockaerts that KB was keeping its eyes and ears open for all posibilities within the framework of international strengthening.
"On that matter, we are holding several talks, also with Rabobank, but nothing more than that," Jaspaert told Reuters.

"We have said we believe in the stand-alone position for our bank but that we also use other formulas of cooperation...in the framework of international expansion," he said. He declined to say with which other banks KB was holding talks.

Rabobank earlier said it had been holding talks over the last year with KB about the unification of European markets, the single euro currency and globalisation of world financial markets but denied the banks wanted to forge a close alliance.
